source.task_prompt: Write a function to sort a list of elements.

generation.text:
```python
def pancake_sort(arr):
    import copy
    arr = copy.deepcopy(arr)
    n = len(arr)
    for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
        # Find the index of the maximum element in arr[0..i]
        max_idx = 0
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            if arr[j] > arr[max_idx]:
                max_idx = j
        # Flip the array up to max_idx
        arr[:max_idx + 1] = arr[:max_idx + 1][::-1]
        # Flip the array up to i
        arr[:i + 1] = arr[:i + 1][::-1]
    return arr
```
